@dataclass
class EstimateResult:
    calculator_version: str
    use_case_id: str
    use_case_name: str
    generated_at: str
    scenarios: List[str]
    line_items: List[LineItem]
    totals: Dict[str, ScenarioTotal]
    compute_decisions: List[ComputeDecision]
    overall_confidence: Dict[str, Any]
    missing_inputs: List[str]
    assumptions_used: List[str]
    warnings: List[str]
    calibration_used: bool
    scope_included: List[str]
    scope_excluded: List[str]
    notes: List[str]
    metadata: Dict[str, Any]

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)

    def to_json(self, indent: int = 2) -> str:
        return json.dumps(self.to_dict(), indent=indent, default=str)

    def line_item_rows(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        return [{**asdict(i), "warnings": "; ".join(i.warnings)} for i in self.line_items]

    def total_rows(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        return [asdict(self.totals[s]) for s in self.scenarios]

    def decision_rows(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        return [{**asdict(d), "eligible": ", ".join(d.eligible)} for d in self.compute_decisions]

    def cost_by_component(self, scenario: str, engines: Optional[Tuple[str, ...]] = None,
                          component_ids: Optional[Tuple[str, ...]] = None, recurrence: str = Recurrence.MONTHLY) -> float:
        """Sum of included cost for a filtered slice of one scenario."""
        return sum(i.cost_usd for i in self.line_items
                   if i.scenario == scenario and i.treatment == Treatment.INCLUDED and i.recurrence == recurrence
                   and (engines is None or i.engine in engines)
                   and (component_ids is None or i.component_id in component_ids))


def _money(v: Optional[float]) -> str:
    return "PENDING" if v is None else f"${v:,.2f}"


def format_summary(result: EstimateResult) -> str:
    """Plain-language summary suitable for an email, a deck note, or an agent reply."""
    t = result.totals
    ref = result.overall_confidence["reference_scenario"]
    lines = [f"DCP Smart Estimation Calculator v{result.calculator_version}",
             f"Use case: {result.use_case_id} | {result.use_case_name}", ""]
    lines.append("Recurring monthly planning range:")
    for sc in result.scenarios:
        tag = " (operating sensitivity, not a forecast)" if sc == "STRESS" else ""
        lines.append(f"  {sc:<9}{_money(t[sc].recurring_monthly_usd):>14}/month{tag}")
    if any(t[sc].one_time_usd or t[sc].pending_one_time_items for sc in result.scenarios):
        lines.append("One-time costs (separate from recurring):")
        for sc in result.scenarios:
            lines.append(f"  {sc:<9}{_money(t[sc].one_time_usd):>14}")
    lines += ["", f"First-year total ({ref}): {_money(t[ref].first_year_usd)} = 12 x recurring + one-time",
              f"Annual recurring, Year 2 onward ({ref}): {_money(t[ref].annual_recurring_usd)}",
              f"Overall confidence: {result.overall_confidence['rating']} - {result.overall_confidence['reason']}"]
    if result.missing_inputs:
        lines += ["", "Pending (not counted, not zero):"] + [f"  - {m}" for m in result.missing_inputs]
    if result.assumptions_used:
        lines += ["", f"Assumptions behind the {ref} figure:"] + [f"  - {a}" for a in result.assumptions_used]
    if result.warnings:
        lines += ["", "Notes:"] + [f"  - {w}" for w in result.warnings]
    if result.scope_included:
        lines += ["", "Included scope: " + "; ".join(result.scope_included)]
    if result.scope_excluded:
        lines += ["Excluded scope: " + "; ".join(result.scope_excluded)]
    lines += ["", "Internal planning estimate, not an invoice or committed run rate."]
    return "\n".join(lines)

    if name not in PRESETS:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown preset {name!r}. Available: {sorted(PRESETS)}")
    return PRESETS[name][0](**overrides)

class DatabricksAccountRateOverlay:
    """Use an exact, currently active row from system.billing.account_prices when exactly
    one distinct price exists; otherwise defer to the base provider (the registry).

    Exact-match rules (same as the registry):
      * provider DATABRICKS and unit DBU only; AWS lookups always go to the base provider
      * region must equal the overlay's region (the account and workspace region);
        any other region defers to the base provider, which fails closed
      * the row must be in effect now (price_start_time <= now < price_end_time)
      * cloud AWS, currency USD, and usage unit DBU when those columns exist
    rate_column is the one price column read. It is not guessed: confirm which column
    holds the account rate (for example $0.3465 for Jobs Serverless) with compare_to_registry().
    """

    def __init__(self, spark, base: Optional[PricingProvider] = None, region: str = "US_EAST_1",
                 rate_column: str = "pricing.default"):
        self.spark, self.base = spark, base or RegistryPricingProvider()
        self.region = region.upper()
        self.rate_column = rate_column
        self._cache: Dict[str, Optional[float]] = {}

    def _lookup(self, sku: str) -> Optional[float]:
        if sku in self._cache:
            return self._cache[sku]
        value = None
        try:
            from pyspark.sql import functions as F
            ap = self.spark.table("system.billing.account_prices")
            q = ap.where(F.upper(F.col("sku_name")) == sku.upper())
            if "price_start_time" in ap.columns:
                q = q.where(F.col("price_start_time") <= F.current_timestamp())
            if "price_end_time" in ap.columns:
                q = q.where(F.col("price_end_time").isNull() | (F.col("price_end_time") > F.current_timestamp()))
            for col_name, expected in (("cloud", "AWS"), ("currency_code", "USD"), ("usage_unit", "DBU")):
                if col_name in ap.columns:
                    q = q.where(F.upper(F.col(col_name)) == expected)
            for col in (self.rate_column,):
                try:
                    vals = [r[0] for r in q.select(F.col(col).cast("double")).where(F.col(col).isNotNull()).distinct().collect()]
                    if len(vals) == 1:
                        value = float(vals[0])
                        break
                except Exception:
                    continue
        except Exception:
            value = None
        self._cache[sku] = value
        return value

    def get_rate(self, provider, sku, unit, region) -> RateQuote:
        if provider.upper() == "DATABRICKS" and unit.upper() == "DBU" and region.upper() == self.region:
            live = self._lookup(sku)
            if live is not None:
                base = self.base.get_rate(provider, sku, unit, region)
                warning = None
                if base.usable and abs(base.rate - live) > 1e-9:
                    warning = (f"Live account rate for {sku} (${live:g}/DBU) differs from the approved "
                               f"rate list (${base.rate:g}/DBU); results will not match presented figures.")
                return RateQuote(live, RateStatus.GOVERNED,
                                 f"system.billing.account_prices (live, {self.rate_column})", warning)
        return self.base.get_rate(provider, sku, unit, region)

    def compare_to_registry(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """One row per Databricks DBU rate in the approved list: approved vs live. Use it to
        confirm rate_column holds the account rate before relying on live rates."""
        base = self.base if isinstance(self.base, RegistryPricingProvider) else RegistryPricingProvider()
        rows = []
        for r in base.rates:
            if r.provider == "DATABRICKS" and r.unit == "DBU" and r.region.upper() == self.region:
                live = self._lookup(r.sku)
                rows.append({"sku": r.sku, "approved_rate": r.rate, "approved_status": r.status,
                             "live_rate": live, "live_column": self.rate_column,
                             "result": ("NO SINGLE LIVE ROW" if live is None else
                                        "MATCH" if r.rate is not None and abs(r.rate - live) < 1e-9 else "DIFFERS")})
        return rows

    def get_model_conversion(self, model, serving_mode):
        return self.base.get_model_conversion(model, serving_mode)


def _percentiles(values) -> Tuple[Optional[float], Optional[float], Optional[float]]:
    a = sorted(float(x) for x in values if x is not None and math.isfinite(float(x)))
    if not a:
        return (None, None, None)

    def q(p):
        z = (len(a) - 1) * p
        i, j = math.floor(z), math.ceil(z)
        return a[i] if i == j else a[i] + (a[j] - a[i]) * (z - i)
    return (q(.25), q(.5), q(.75))


def calibrate_from_system_tables(spark, workspace_id: str, lookback_days: int = 90) -> CalibrationData:
    """Read-only calibration from system.billing.usage and system.query.history.

    Continuous peers: jobs running >= 60 days and >= 18 hours/day (monthly DBU).
    Batch peers:      jobs running <= 10 days and <= 10 hours/day (DBU per hour).
    SQL peers:        SQL Pro warehouses (monthly DBU).
    Results depend on the 90-day window, so they change over time. Lock values in a
    preset (dbu_per_hour) once an estimate has been presented.
    """
    from pyspark.sql import functions as F
    from pyspark.sql.window import Window

    out = CalibrationData(source=f"system.billing.usage workspace {workspace_id}, {lookback_days} days")
    u = (spark.table("system.billing.usage")
         .where(F.col("workspace_id").cast("string") == workspace_id)
         .where(F.col("usage_start_time") >= F.date_sub(F.current_timestamp(), lookback_days))
         .select("usage_start_time", "usage_end_time", F.col("usage_quantity").cast("double").alias("dbu"),
                 F.upper("sku_name").alias("sku"),
                 F.coalesce(F.col("usage_metadata.job_id").cast("string"),
                            F.col("usage_metadata.cluster_id").cast("string")).alias("resource"),
                 F.col("usage_metadata.warehouse_id").cast("string").alias("warehouse")))
    jobs = (u.where(F.col("sku").contains("JOBS") & F.col("resource").isNotNull()).groupBy("resource")
            .agg(F.sum("dbu").alias("dbu"), F.countDistinct(F.to_date("usage_start_time")).alias("days"),
                 F.sum((F.unix_timestamp("usage_end_time") - F.unix_timestamp("usage_start_time")) / 3600).alias("hours"))
            .withColumn("hpd", F.col("hours") / F.greatest("days", F.lit(1))))
    cont = [r[0] for r in jobs.where((F.col("days") >= 60) & (F.col("hpd") >= 18))
            .select(F.col("dbu") * 30 / lookback_days).collect()]
    batch = [r[0] for r in jobs.where((F.col("days") <= 10) & (F.col("hpd") <= 10) & (F.col("hours") > 0))
             .select(F.col("dbu") / F.col("hours")).collect()]
    sql = [r[0] for r in u.where(F.col("sku").contains("SQL") & F.col("sku").contains("PRO") & F.col("warehouse").isNotNull())
           .groupBy("warehouse").agg((F.sum("dbu") * 30 / lookback_days).alias("m")).select("m").collect()]
    out.continuous_peers, out.continuous_monthly_dbu = len(cont), _percentiles(cont)
    out.batch_peers, out.batch_dbu_per_hour = len(batch), _percentiles(batch)
    out.sql_peers, out.sql_monthly_dbu = len(sql), _percentiles(sql)
    try:
        q = (spark.table("system.query.history").where(F.col("workspace_id").cast("string") == workspace_id)
             .where(F.col("start_time") >= F.date_sub(F.current_timestamp(), lookback_days))
             .where(F.col("end_time").isNotNull()))
        ev = (q.select(F.col("start_time").alias("t"), F.lit(1).alias("d"))
              .unionByName(q.select(F.col("end_time").alias("t"), F.lit(-1).alias("d")))
              .groupBy("t").agg(F.sum("d").alias("d")))
        w = Window.orderBy("t").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, 0)
        out.peak_concurrent_statements = ev.withColumn("a", F.sum("d").over(w)).agg(F.max("a")).first()[0]
        if "executed_by" in q.columns:
            peak_users = q.groupBy("start_time").agg(F.countDistinct("executed_by").alias("u")).agg(F.max("u")).first()[0]
            out.ten_concurrent_users_validated = (peak_users or 0) >= 10
    except Exception:
        out.source += " | concurrency unavailable"
    return out

"""Thin adapter between the DCP calculator (notebooks/dcp_estimator.py) and Unity Catalog / Genie.

It does no math. It only:
  * builds the EstimateRequest: a preset ({"preset": "SEND_US01", "preset_args": {...}}) or a plain request JSON,
  * applies what-if overrides: preset keyword arguments (e.g. {"migration_gb": 8000}) and/or dotted paths on the
    request (e.g. {"transfer.daily_gb_high": -1}, {"processing[C02].runs_per_month": 4}),
  * builds the calculator's RegistryPricingProvider from the rate card (dcp_rate_card) - nothing else,
  * calls estimate() and returns result.to_dict() reshaped into lists for SQL, plus format_summary().
Validation errors (ValueError) come back as status REJECTED with the calculator's own messages.
"""
import json

DISCLAIMER = "Internal planning estimate, not an invoice or committed run rate."
# "Core monthly" in the DCP output format: Databricks processing + SQL + recurring DataSync (no S3/KMS, no model API)
CORE_ENGINES = ("DATA_PROCESSING", "SQL_REPORTING", "DATA_TRANSFER")


def _apply_paths(d, paths):
    for path, val in paths.items():
        head, _, field = path.rpartition(".")
        if not head:
            d[field] = val
        elif head.startswith("processing[") and head.endswith("]"):
            cid = head[len("processing["):-1]
            hits = [c for c in d.get("processing") or [] if c.get("component_id") == cid or str(c.get("component_id", "")).endswith("-" + cid)]
            if not hits:
                raise ValueError(f"Override {path}: no processing component {cid!r}.")
            for c in hits:
                c[field] = val
        else:
            if d.get(head) is None:
                d[head] = {}
            if not isinstance(d[head], dict):
                raise ValueError(f"Override {path}: {head} is not an object.")
            d[head][field] = val
    return d


def build_request(m, request, overrides=None):
    overrides = dict(overrides or {})
    paths = {k: v for k, v in overrides.items() if "." in k or "[" in k}
    kwargs = {k: v for k, v in overrides.items() if k not in paths}
    if "preset" in request:
        args = {**(request.get("preset_args") or {}), **kwargs}
        req = m.load_preset(request["preset"], **args)
        if not paths:
            return req
        d = req.to_dict()
    else:
        if kwargs:
            paths.update(kwargs)
        d = json.loads(json.dumps(request))
    return m.EstimateRequest.from_dict(_apply_paths(d, paths))


def build_pricing(m, rates):
    """rates = {"as_of": "YYYY-MM-DD", "source": ..., "rows": [RateRecord fields...]}. Only these rows are used."""
    fields = {"provider", "service", "sku", "unit", "region", "rate", "status", "source",
              "effective_start", "effective_end", "observed_rate", "notes"}
    records = []
    for r in (rates or {}).get("rows") or []:
        rec = {k: r.get(k) for k in fields if r.get(k) is not None or k in ("rate", "effective_end", "observed_rate")}
        rec.setdefault("notes", "")
        rec.setdefault("effective_start", "2026-01-01")
        records.append(m.RateRecord(**rec))
    as_of = (rates or {}).get("as_of") or m.DEFAULT_AS_OF
    return m.RegistryPricingProvider(rates=records, conversions=m.DEFAULT_MODEL_CONVERSIONS, as_of=as_of)


def _split(s):
    cid, _, rest = s.partition(": ")
    return {"component_id": cid, "reason": rest or s}


def shape(m, result, rates, areas=None):
    d = result.to_dict()
    totals = []
    c2 = lambda x: None if x is None else float(f"{x:.2f}")   # same rounding as the calculator's format_summary
    for sc in d["scenarios"]:
        t = d["totals"][sc]
        core = result.cost_by_component(sc, engines=CORE_ENGINES)   # calculator's own slice: processing + SQL + DataSync
        totals.append({"scenario": sc, "label": "STRESS (operating sensitivity, not a forecast)" if sc == "STRESS" else sc,
                       "recurring_monthly_usd": c2(t["recurring_monthly_usd"]), "core_monthly_usd": c2(core),
                       "annual_usd": c2(t["annual_recurring_usd"]), "one_time_usd": c2(t["one_time_usd"]),
                       "first_year_usd": c2(t["first_year_usd"]), "databricks_dbu": c2(t["databricks_dbu_monthly"]),
                       "databricks_usd": c2(t["databricks_monthly_usd"]), "aws_usd": c2(t["aws_monthly_usd"]),
                       "pending_items": t["pending_recurring_items"] + t["pending_one_time_items"], "status": t["status"]})
    lines = [{**li, "warnings": "; ".join(li["warnings"])} for li in d["line_items"]]
    decisions = [{**x, "eligible": ", ".join(x["eligible"])} for x in d["compute_decisions"]]
    used = sorted({f"{li['rate_status']} ${li['rate']:g}/{li['unit']} - {li['rate_source']}" for li in d["line_items"] if li["rate"] is not None})
    return {"status": "OK", "errors": [],
            "header": {"calculator_version": d["calculator_version"], "use_case_id": d["use_case_id"], "use_case_name": d["use_case_name"],
                       "generated_at": d["generated_at"], "rate_card_source": (rates or {}).get("source"),
                       "rate_card_as_of": (rates or {}).get("as_of"), "calibration_used": d["calibration_used"]},
            "totals": totals, "line_items": lines, "compute_decisions": decisions,
            "confidence": d["overall_confidence"],
            "pending": [_split(s) for s in d["missing_inputs"]],
            "assumptions": d["assumptions_used"], "warnings": d["warnings"],
            "scope": {"included": d["scope_included"], "excluded": d["scope_excluded"], "rates_used": used},
            "areas": areas or [], "notes": d["notes"], "summary": m.format_summary(result), "disclaimer": DISCLAIMER}


def run(m, request, rates, overrides=None, named=None):
    """Entry point used by the Unity Catalog function. Always returns JSON text.
    named = True / False runs the input check first (named use case / ad-hoc or pasted JSON): if anything required is
    missing or invalid, nothing is priced and status NEEDS_INPUT lists each question. named = None skips the check."""
    if named is not None:
        blocking = [r for r in check(m, request, overrides, named) if r["blocking"]]
        if blocking:
            areas = next((json.loads(r["received"]) for r in blocking if r["issue"] == "AREA_UNCONFIRMED"), None)
            step = ("When the user answers, make the SAME call again with every earlier value plus the answers - never write a request JSON yourself. "
                    "Missing values: add them as dcp_request arguments (or, for a pasted JSON kept verbatim, as p_overrides dotted paths). ")
            if areas:
                try:
                    rq = json.loads(request) if isinstance(request, str) else dict(request)
                    ov = json.loads(overrides) if isinstance(overrides, str) and overrides else dict(overrides or {})
                    ov.update({f"_areas.{x}": "NOT_APPLICABLE" for x in areas.split(",")})
                    lit = lambda o: json.dumps(o, separators=(",", ":")).replace("'", "''")
                    step += ("If the user says the other / remaining areas are not applicable, run exactly: SELECT * FROM <SCHEMA>.dcp_calc_totals("
                             f"p_request => '{lit(rq)}', p_overrides => '{lit(ov)}') - and add any other values the user gave as dotted p_overrides "
                             "keys (e.g. \"processing[ADHOC-C01].runs_per_month\": 30, \"storage.s3_read_requests_per_file\": 2). Otherwise: ")
                except (ValueError, TypeError):
                    pass
                step += (f"Area states for {areas}: dcp_request(... same arguments ..., p_not_applicable_areas => '<areas>', p_excluded_areas => '<areas>', "
                         f"p_unknown_areas => '<areas>') using only the areas the user named; 'the other areas are not applicable' = "
                         f"p_not_applicable_areas => '{areas}'. For a pasted JSON: p_overrides => '{{\"_areas.<area>\": \"NOT_APPLICABLE\"}}'.")
            return json.dumps({"status": "NEEDS_INPUT", "next_step": step, "totals": [], "line_items": [], "compute_decisions": [], "confidence": None,
                               "errors": [f"{r['issue']} {r['field']}" + (f" ({r['component_id']})" if r["component_id"] else "")
                                          + (f", received {r['received']}" if r["received"] is not None else "") + f": {r['question']}"
                                          for r in blocking],
                               "pending": [], "assumptions": [], "warnings": [], "scope": None, "notes": [],
                               "header": {"calculator_version": getattr(m, "CALCULATOR_VERSION", None)}, "summary": None,
                               "disclaimer": DISCLAIMER})
    try:
        req = json.loads(request) if isinstance(request, str) else request
        rt = json.loads(rates) if isinstance(rates, str) and rates else (rates or {})
        ov = json.loads(overrides) if isinstance(overrides, str) and overrides else (overrides or {})
        if not isinstance(req, dict):
            raise ValueError(f"Request must be a JSON object, got {type(req).__name__}.")
        if not isinstance(ov, dict):
            raise ValueError("Overrides must be a JSON object of field: value pairs.")
        built = build_request(m, req, ov)
        result = m.estimate(built, build_pricing(m, rt))
        return json.dumps(shape(m, result, rt, area_states(built, req.get("_areas"), named)), default=str)
    except (ValueError, TypeError) as e:
        msgs = [x.strip(" -") for x in str(e).replace("Invalid estimate request:", "").split("\n") if x.strip(" -")]
        return json.dumps({"status": "REJECTED", "errors": msgs, "totals": [], "line_items": [], "compute_decisions": [],
                           "confidence": None, "pending": [], "assumptions": [], "warnings": [], "scope": None, "notes": [],
                           "header": {"calculator_version": getattr(m, "CALCULATOR_VERSION", None)}, "summary": None,
                           "disclaimer": DISCLAIMER})

class _Issues:
    def __init__(self):
        self.rows = []

    def add(self, section, cid, field, issue, expected, received=None, blocking=True, question=None):
        self.rows.append({"section": section, "component_id": cid, "field": field, "issue": issue, "blocking": blocking,
                          "expected": expected, "received": None if received is None else json.dumps(received, default=str),
                          "question": question or QUESTIONS.get(field) or f"Please provide {field} for {cid or section}."})

    def has(self, section, cid, field):
        return any(r["section"] == section and r["component_id"] == cid and r["field"] == field for r in self.rows)


def _is_num(v):
    return isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool)


def _check_types(m, typ, d, section, cid, out):
    """Every supplied value must have the declared type: numbers as numbers (30, not "30"), true/false, text."""
    import difflib, math
    allowed = {f.name: f for f in m.fields(typ)}
    for k, v in d.items():
        if k.startswith("_"):
            continue
        if k not in allowed:
            near = difflib.get_close_matches(k, list(allowed), 1)
            out.add(section, cid, k, "UNKNOWN_FIELD", f"one of {sorted(allowed)}", k,
                    question=f"{k!r} is not a {section} field" + (f" - did you mean {near[0]!r}?" if near else "; please remove or rename it."))
            continue
        if v is None:
            continue
        f_, t = allowed[k], m._type_text(allowed[k])
        if m._is_numeric_field(f_):
            whole = t in ("int", "Optional[int]")
            if not _is_num(v):
                out.add(section, cid, k, "WRONG_TYPE", "a whole number" if whole else "a number", v,
                        question=f"{k} must be a number without quotes (got {v!r}). What is the correct value?")
            elif not math.isfinite(v) or v < 0:
                out.add(section, cid, k, "INVALID_VALUE", "a number of 0 or more", v,
                        question=f"{k} cannot be {v!r}. What is the correct value (0 or more)?")
            elif whole and v != int(v):
                out.add(section, cid, k, "WRONG_TYPE", "a whole number", v,
                        question=f"{k} must be a whole number (got {v!r}). What is the correct value?")
        elif m._is_bool_field(f_) and not isinstance(v, bool):
            out.add(section, cid, k, "WRONG_TYPE", "true or false", v, question=f"Is {k} true or false (got {v!r})?")
        elif m._is_str_field(f_) and not isinstance(v, str):
            out.add(section, cid, k, "WRONG_TYPE", "text", v, question=f"{k} must be text (got {v!r}). What is the correct value?")
        elif t.startswith("Optional[Dict") and not (isinstance(v, dict) and all(_is_num(x) for x in v.values())):
            out.add(section, cid, k, "WRONG_TYPE", 'a scenario map such as {"EXPECTED": 1.0, "HIGH": 1.5}', v)
    for k in m._required_fields(typ):
        if d.get(k) is None:
            out.add(section, cid, k, "MISSING", "required", None)


def _check_enum(d, field, values, section, cid, out):
    v = d.get(field)
    if isinstance(v, str) and v not in values:
        out.add(section, cid, field, "INVALID_VALUE", f"one of {list(values)}", v,
                question=f"{field} {v!r} is not recognised. Which one applies: {', '.join(values)}?")


def _need(d, field, section, cid, out):
    if d.get(field) is None and not out.has(section, cid, field):
        out.add(section, cid, field, "MISSING", "required: no default, the cost would be PENDING", None)


def _check_range(d, base, scenarios, section, cid, out, has_expected=True):
    """A low / expected / high value per scenario. The expected value (or, without an expected field, low and high)
    is required; a missing low or high bound only leaves that scenario PENDING, so it is reported but not blocking."""
    lo, ex, hi = (d.get(f"{base}_{b}") for b in ("low", "expected", "high"))
    if has_expected:
        if ex is None and lo is None and hi is None:
            _need(d, f"{base}_expected", section, cid, out)
            return
        if ex is None and "EXPECTED" in scenarios and not (base.endswith("tokens") and lo is not None and hi is not None):
            _need(d, f"{base}_expected", section, cid, out)
    else:
        for b in ("low", "high"):
            _need(d, f"{base}_{b}", section, cid, out)
        return
    for sc in scenarios:
        b = SCENARIO_BOUND.get(sc)
        if b in ("low", "high") and d.get(f"{base}_{b}") is None and not out.has(section, cid, f"{base}_{b}"):
            out.add(section, cid, f"{base}_{b}", "RANGE_BOUND_MISSING", f"optional: without it {sc} is PENDING", None, blocking=False)


def _check_request(m, d, out):
    if not isinstance(d, dict):
        out.add("request", None, "request", "WRONG_TYPE", "a JSON object", d, question="Please send the request as a JSON object.")
        return
    top = {k: v for k, v in d.items() if k not in {s for s, _, _ in SECTIONS} and k != "assumptions"}
    _check_types(m, m.EstimateRequest, top, "request", None, out)
    scenarios = d.get("scenarios") or ["LOW", "EXPECTED", "HIGH"]
    if not isinstance(scenarios, list) or [s for s in scenarios if s not in m.SCENARIOS_ALL]:
        out.add("request", None, "scenarios", "INVALID_VALUE", f"a list drawn from {list(m.SCENARIOS_ALL)}", scenarios)
        scenarios = ["LOW", "EXPECTED", "HIGH"]
    present = 0
    convs = {(c.model, c.serving_mode) for c in m.DEFAULT_MODEL_CONVERSIONS}
    for key, cls, is_list in SECTIONS:
        val = d.get(key)
        if val is None:
            continue
        if is_list and not isinstance(val, list) or not is_list and not isinstance(val, dict):
            out.add(key, None, key, "WRONG_TYPE", "a list of objects" if is_list else "a JSON object", val,
                    question=f"{key} must be {'a list of objects' if is_list else 'a JSON object'}. Please resend it.")
            continue
        for n, item in enumerate(val if is_list else [val]):
            label = f"{key}[{n}]" if is_list else key
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                out.add(key, None, label, "WRONG_TYPE", "a JSON object", item, question=f"{label} must be a JSON object.")
                continue
            present += 1
            cid = item.get("component_id") if isinstance(item.get("component_id"), str) else label
            _check_types(m, getattr(m, cls), item, key, cid, out)
            if key == "processing":
                _check_enum(item, "workload_type", m.WORKLOAD_TYPES, key, cid, out)
                _check_enum(item, "streaming_mode", STREAMING_MODES, key, cid, out)
                _check_enum(item, "latency_requirement", LATENCIES, key, cid, out)
                _check_enum(item, "dbu_per_hour_evidence", m.Evidence.ALL, key, cid, out)
                if _is_num(item.get("quantity")) and item["quantity"] < 1:
                    out.add(key, cid, "quantity", "INVALID_VALUE", "1 or more", item["quantity"],
                            question="How many identical copies of this workload run (1 or more)?")
                if item.get("workload_type") in m.WORKLOAD_TYPES and item["workload_type"] != "CONTINUOUS_STREAMING":
                    _check_range(item, "runtime_hours", scenarios, key, cid, out)
                    if item["workload_type"] != "EVENT_DRIVEN_BATCH":   # event-driven has a planning default
                        _need(item, "runs_per_month", key, cid, out)
            elif key == "sql":
                if _is_num(item.get("concurrent_users")) and item["concurrent_users"] < 1:
                    out.add(key, cid, "concurrent_users", "INVALID_VALUE", "1 or more", item["concurrent_users"])
            elif key == "transfer":
                _check_range(item, "daily_gb", scenarios, key, cid, out)
            elif key == "storage":
                for f_ in ("retained_tb", "files_per_day", "s3_read_requests_per_file"):
                    _need(item, f_, key, cid, out)
                if "s3_write_requests_per_file" in item:
                    _need(item, "s3_write_requests_per_file", key, cid, out)
                if (item.get("encrypted_files_per_day") or 0) and "kms_requests_per_encrypted_file" in item:
                    _need(item, "kms_requests_per_encrypted_file", key, cid, out)
            else:   # model_endpoints, one_time_model_jobs
                mode = item.get("serving_mode") or "PAY_PER_TOKEN"
                known = sorted(mm for mm, sm in convs if sm == mode)
                if mode != "PAY_PER_TOKEN":
                    out.add(key, cid, "serving_mode", "INVALID_VALUE", "PAY_PER_TOKEN", mode,
                            question="Only pay-per-token model serving can be estimated here. Is it PAY_PER_TOKEN?")
                elif isinstance(item.get("model"), str) and item["model"] not in known:
                    out.add(key, cid, "model", "INVALID_VALUE", f"one of {known}", item["model"],
                            question=f"Model {item['model']!r} has no pricing. Which of these is it: {', '.join(known)}?")
                for base in ("input_tokens", "output_tokens"):
                    _check_range(item, base, scenarios, key, cid, out, has_expected=(key == "model_endpoints"))
    raw = d.get("_areas")
    if raw is not None and not isinstance(raw, dict):
        out.add("request", None, "_areas", "WRONG_TYPE", 'an object such as {"transfer": "NOT_APPLICABLE"}', raw)
        raw = {}
    raw = raw or {}
    for k in raw:
        if k not in AREAS:
            out.add("request", None, f"_areas.{k}", "UNKNOWN_FIELD", f"one of {list(AREAS)}", k,
                    question=f"{k!r} is not a calculator area. The areas are: {', '.join(AREAS)}.")
    unconfirmed = []
    for a, label in AREAS.items():
        state = raw.get(a)
        if isinstance(state, str):
            state = state.upper()
        if state is not None and state not in AREA_STATES:
            out.add("request", None, f"_areas.{a}", "INVALID_VALUE", f"one of {list(AREA_STATES)}", raw.get(a),
                    question=f"Is {label} Included, Excluded, Unknown or Not Applicable?")
        elif _has(d.get(a)):
            if state in ("EXCLUDED", "NOT_APPLICABLE"):
                out.add(a, None, f"_areas.{a}", "INVALID_VALUE", "INCLUDED (inputs were supplied)", raw.get(a),
                        question=f"{label} has inputs but is marked {state}. Should it be included, or should its inputs be removed?")
        elif state == "INCLUDED":
            out.add(a, None, a, "MISSING", "required: the area is included but has no inputs", None,
                    question=f"{label} is included: what are {AREA_NEEDS[a]}?")
        elif state is None:
            unconfirmed.append(a)
    if unconfirmed and present:
        out.add("request", None, "_areas", "AREA_UNCONFIRMED", f"each of {unconfirmed} marked {'/'.join(AREA_STATES)}", ",".join(unconfirmed),
                question="Before the estimate is final, every calculator area must be confirmed. For each of these, is it Included "
                         "(then give its inputs), Excluded, Unknown or Not Applicable: "
                         + "; ".join(AREAS[a] for a in unconfirmed) + "?")
    if not present and "INCLUDED" not in {str(v).upper() for v in raw.values()}:
        out.add("request", None, "workload", "NO_WORKLOAD", "at least one section", None,
                question="What should be estimated? Describe the processing workload (type, runtime per run, runs per month), "
                         "SQL users, daily DataSync GB, S3 storage (TB, files per day, reads per file) or model calls and tokens.")


def check(m, request, overrides=None, named=False):
    """List what must be supplied or corrected before estimating. Named use cases were validated when they were loaded,
    so only the request as built (with any what-if overrides) is validated; ad-hoc and pasted JSON requests are also
    checked for every input that has no calculator default. Anything the calculator itself would reject is reported too."""
    out = _Issues()
    try:
        req = json.loads(request) if isinstance(request, str) else request
    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
        out.add("request", None, "request", "NOT_JSON", "valid JSON", None,
                question=f"The request is not valid JSON ({e.msg} at line {e.lineno}, column {e.colno}). Please correct and resend it.")
        return out.rows
    try:
        ov = json.loads(overrides) if isinstance(overrides, str) and overrides else (overrides or {})
    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
        out.add("overrides", None, "overrides", "NOT_JSON", "valid JSON", None,
                question=f"The what-if changes are not valid JSON ({e.msg}). Please resend them as field: value pairs.")
        return out.rows
    if not named and isinstance(req, dict) and "preset" not in req:
        _check_request(m, _apply_paths(json.loads(json.dumps(req)), ov) if isinstance(ov, dict) else req, out)
    if not any(r["blocking"] for r in out.rows):
        try:   # the calculator's own validation, so the check is never looser than the estimate
            if not isinstance(req, dict):
                raise ValueError(f"Request must be a JSON object, got {type(req).__name__}.")
            if not isinstance(ov, dict):
                raise ValueError("Overrides must be a JSON object of field: value pairs.")
            m.validate_request(build_request(m, req, ov))
        except (ValueError, TypeError) as e:
            for msg in [x.strip(" -") for x in str(e).replace("Invalid estimate request:", "").split("\n") if x.strip(" -")]:
                out.add("request", None, "request", "INVALID_VALUE", "a valid request", None, question=f"{msg}. Please correct it.")
    return out.rows


def run_check(m, request, overrides=None, named=False):
    """Entry point used by the Unity Catalog function dcp_check. Always returns JSON text."""
    rows = check(m, request, overrides, named)
    return json.dumps({"status": "NEEDS_INPUT" if any(r["blocking"] for r in rows) else "READY", "issues": rows}, default=str)


def intake_questions(m):
    """Rows (area, field, type, requirement, default_value, question) for the guided intake, from the request schema."""
    from dataclasses import MISSING
    classes = dict((key, cls) for key, cls, _ in SECTIONS)
    rows = []
    for area, cls in classes.items():
        for f_ in m.fields(getattr(m, cls)):
            if f_.name in INTAKE_SKIP:
                continue
            default = None if f_.default is MISSING else f_.default
            req = "REQUIRED" if f_.name in INTAKE_REQUIRED[area] else ("DEFAULT" if default is not None else "OPTIONAL")
            if area == "processing" and f_.name == "runs_per_month":
                req = "REQUIRED for batch types (EVENT_DRIVEN_BATCH: planning default runs); not used for CONTINUOUS_STREAMING"
            elif area == "processing" and f_.name == "runtime_hours_expected":
                req = "REQUIRED for batch types; not used for CONTINUOUS_STREAMING"
            rows.append((area, f_.name, m._type_text(f_), req, None if default is None else json.dumps(default),
                         QUESTIONS.get(f_.name) or f"{f_.name.replace('_', ' ').capitalize()}?"))
    return rows

dcp_check_inputs.routine_definition:
WITH p AS (SELECT CASE WHEN upper(trim(p_use_case)) IN ('', 'NULL', 'NONE', 'N/A') THEN NULL ELSE p_use_case END AS uc, CASE WHEN upper(trim(p_request)) IN ('', 'NULL', 'NONE', 'N/A') THEN NULL ELSE p_request END AS rq, CASE WHEN upper(trim(p_overrides)) IN ('', 'NULL', 'NONE', 'N/A') THEN NULL ELSE p_overrides END AS ov),
  req AS (
    SELECT coalesce(get_json_object(p.rq, '$.use_case_id'), 'ADHOC') AS use_case_id, p.rq AS r, p.ov, false AS named FROM p WHERE p.rq IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT use_case_id, request_json, ov, true FROM (
      SELECT q.use_case_id, q.request_json, p.ov, m.rnk, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY m.rnk) AS n_at_rank, min(m.rnk) OVER () AS best
      FROM __FQ__.dcp_requests q JOIN p ON p.rq IS NULL
      LATERAL VIEW explode(array(
        CASE WHEN upper(trim(q.use_case_id)) = upper(trim(p.uc)) OR upper(trim(q.use_case_name)) = upper(trim(p.uc)) THEN 1
             WHEN startswith(upper(q.use_case_id), upper(trim(p.uc))) OR startswith(upper(q.use_case_name), upper(trim(p.uc))) THEN 2 END)) m AS rnk
      WHERE m.rnk IS NOT NULL)
    WHERE rnk = best AND n_at_rank = 1),
  chk AS (SELECT req.use_case_id, from_json(__FQ__.dcp_check(req.r, req.ov, req.named),
                 'struct<status:string,issues:array<struct<section:string,component_id:string,field:string,issue:string,blocking:boolean,expected:string,received:string,question:string>>>') AS j
          FROM req)
  SELECT chk.use_case_id, chk.j.status, i.section, i.component_id, i.field, i.issue, i.blocking, i.expected, i.received, i.question
  FROM chk LATERAL VIEW OUTER explode(chk.j.issues) x AS i
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.uc, 'UNKNOWN_USE_CASE', 'request', NULL, 'p_use_case', 'UNKNOWN_USE_CASE', true, 'a loaded use case id or name', p.uc,
         'No single loaded use case matches this name. Which use case is it (SELECT use_case_id, use_case_name FROM __FQ__.dcp_requests)?'
  FROM p WHERE p.rq IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM req)

dcp_intake_questions.comment: DCP GUIDED INTAKE - request fields and REQUIRED/DEFAULT/OPTIONAL questions from the calculator schema. p_area is an area id: processing, sql, transfer, storage, model_endpoints, or one_time_model_jobs; use processing for scheduled batch and streaming workloads, not the workload type as p_area. Show defaults to users. Use after discovery or when no facts are provided; dcp_check_inputs returns exact missing-input questions for partially supplied requests.

    ('processing', 'runs_per_month', 'Optional[float]', 'REQUIRED for batch types (EVENT_DRIVEN_BATCH: planning default runs); not used for CONTINUOUS_STREAMING', NULL, 'How many runs per month?'),

  WHERE CASE WHEN upper(trim(p_area)) IN ('', 'NULL', 'NONE', 'N/A') THEN NULL ELSE p_area END IS NULL OR area = lower(trim(p_area))

dcp_request.comment: Build a DCP EstimateRequest using only these named arguments; never invent aliases. Processing: p_workload_type, p_runtime_hours_low/expected/high, p_runs_per_month, p_component_id. SQL: p_concurrent_users, p_total_users, p_working_days_per_month, p_sql_component_id. Transfer: p_daily_gb_low/expected/high, p_transfer_days_per_month, p_initial_transfer_gb. Storage: p_retained_tb, p_files_per_day, p_s3_read_requests_per_file, optional S3/KMS fields. Recurring model: p_model, p_calls_per_day, p_input_tokens_low/expected/high, p_output_tokens_low/expected/high, p_model_component_id. One-time job: p_one_time_model, p_one_time_input_tokens_low/high, p_one_time_output_tokens_low/high, p_one_time_api_calls, p_one_time_component_id. Missing required inputs are returned by dcp_calc_* validation; never fill them. Defaults: US_EAST_1, 22 SQL/transfer days, 30 storage/model days, 1 S3 write request/file, 1 KMS request/encrypted file. Daily frequency is not a runs/month value; only EVENT_DRIVEN_BATCH has a planning default. One runtime per run applies to all scenarios. Scenarios default LOW,EXPECTED,HIGH; STRESS only when asked. Confirm each area using INCLUDED, EXCLUDED, UNKNOWN, NOT_APPLICABLE parameters.

to_json(named_struct(
  'use_case_id', p_use_case_id, 'use_case_name', p_use_case_name,

estimate_ai_classify_cost.routine_definition:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT (COALESCE(p_num_docs,0)/1000.0) * CASE lower(COALESCE(p_document_type,'custom'))
           WHEN 'short_text' THEN 4.5 WHEN 'rental_contract' THEN 50.0 ELSE COALESCE(p_custom_rate_per_1000,0) END dbu_m,
         __FQ__.get_dbu_price(p_cloud,p_region,p_tier,'SERVERLESS_REAL_TIME_INFERENCE') price)
  SELECT 'AI_CLASSIFY', 0.0, 0.0, dbu_m, price, round(dbu_m*price,2), 0.0, round(dbu_m*price,2) FROM b

estimate_ai_extract_cost.routine_definition:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT (COALESCE(p_num_inputs,0)/1000.0) * CASE lower(COALESCE(p_document_type,'custom'))
           WHEN 'short_text' THEN 45.0 WHEN 'invoice' THEN 45.0 WHEN 'complex_reasoning' THEN 562.5 WHEN 'deep_nesting' THEN 537.5 ELSE COALESCE(p_custom_rate_per_1000,0) END dbu_m,
         __FQ__.get_dbu_price(p_cloud,p_region,p_tier,'SERVERLESS_REAL_TIME_INFERENCE') price)
  SELECT 'AI_EXTRACT', 0.0, 0.0, dbu_m, price, round(dbu_m*price,2), 0.0, round(dbu_m*price,2) FROM b

estimate_ai_parse_cost.routine_definition:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(p_mode,'pages'))='dbu' THEN COALESCE(p_hours_per_month,0)
         ELSE COALESCE(p_pages_thousands,0) * CASE lower(COALESCE(p_complexity,'medium'))
           WHEN 'low_text' THEN 12.5 WHEN 'low_images' THEN 22.5 WHEN 'high' THEN 87.5 ELSE 62.5 END END dbu_m,
         __FQ__.get_dbu_price(p_cloud,p_region,p_tier,'SERVERLESS_REAL_TIME_INFERENCE') price)
  SELECT 'AI_PARSE', 0.0, 0.0, dbu_m, price, round(dbu_m*price,2), 0.0, round(dbu_m*price,2) FROM b

estimate_all_purpose_classic_cost.routine_definition:
WITH b AS (
    SELECT __FQ__.calculate_classic_compute_dbu(p_cloud,p_driver_node_type,p_worker_node_type,p_num_workers,p_photon_enabled,'ALL_PURPOSE',NULL) dbu_ph,
           __FQ__.calculate_hours_per_month('ALL_PURPOSE',p_runs_per_day,p_avg_runtime_minutes,p_days_per_month,NULL) hrs,
           __FQ__.get_dbu_price(p_cloud,p_region,p_tier,__FQ__.get_product_type_for_pricing('ALL_PURPOSE',false,p_photon_enabled,NULL,NULL,NULL)) price,
           __FQ__.get_vm_cost_per_hour(p_cloud,p_region,p_driver_node_type,'on_demand','NA') drv,
           __FQ__.get_vm_cost_per_hour(p_cloud,p_region,p_worker_node_type,'on_demand','NA') wrk)
  SELECT 'ALL_PURPOSE_CLASSIC', dbu_ph, hrs, dbu_ph*hrs, price, round(dbu_ph*hrs*price,2),
         round((drv + wrk*COALESCE(p_num_workers,0))*hrs,2),
         round(dbu_ph*hrs*price + (drv + wrk*COALESCE(p_num_workers,0))*hrs,2) FROM b

estimate_databricks_apps_cost.routine_definition:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT (CASE WHEN lower(p_app_size)='large' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.5 END)*COALESCE(p_num_apps,1) dbu_ph,
         COALESCE(p_hours_per_month,730.0) hrs,
         __FQ__.get_dbu_price(p_cloud,p_region,p_tier,'ALL_PURPOSE_SERVERLESS_COMPUTE') price)
  SELECT 'DATABRICKS_APPS', dbu_ph, hrs, dbu_ph*hrs, price, round(dbu_ph*hrs*price,2), 0.0, round(dbu_ph*hrs*price,2) FROM b

estimate_dbsql_cost.comment: Monthly cost estimate for a Databricks SQL warehouse. p_warehouse_type in classic/pro/serverless; serverless has no separate VM cost.

estimate_dbsql_cost.routine_definition:
WITH whc AS (
    SELECT driver_instance_type di, worker_instance_type wi, worker_count wc
    FROM __FQ__.ref_dbsql_warehouse_config
    WHERE upper(cloud)=upper(p_cloud) AND lower(warehouse_size)=lower(p_warehouse_type) AND upper(warehouse_type)=upper(p_warehouse_size) LIMIT 1),
  calc AS (
    SELECT __FQ__.calculate_dbsql_dbu(p_cloud,p_warehouse_type,p_warehouse_size,p_num_clusters) dbu_ph,
           __FQ__.calculate_hours_per_month('DBSQL',p_runs_per_day,p_avg_runtime_minutes,p_days_per_month,p_hours_per_month) hrs,
           __FQ__.get_dbu_price(p_cloud,p_region,p_tier,__FQ__.get_product_type_for_pricing('DBSQL',false,false,NULL,p_warehouse_type,NULL)) price,
           CASE WHEN lower(p_warehouse_type)='serverless' THEN 0.0 ELSE
             __FQ__.get_vm_cost_per_hour(p_cloud,p_region,whc.di,'on_demand','NA')*COALESCE(p_num_clusters,1)
             + __FQ__.get_vm_cost_per_hour(p_cloud,p_region,whc.wi,'on_demand','NA')*COALESCE(whc.wc,0)*COALESCE(p_num_clusters,1)
           END vm_ph
    FROM (SELECT 1 one) d LEFT JOIN whc ON true)
  SELECT 'DBSQL_'||upper(p_warehouse_type), dbu_ph, hrs, dbu_ph*hrs, price, round(dbu_ph*hrs*price,2),
         round(vm_ph*hrs,2), round(dbu_ph*hrs*price + vm_ph*hrs,2) FROM calc

WITH b AS (
    SELECT __FQ__.calculate_classic_compute_dbu(p_cloud,p_driver_node_type,p_worker_node_type,p_num_workers,p_photon_enabled,'DLT',p_dlt_edition) dbu_ph,
           __FQ__.calculate_hours_per_month('DLT',p_runs_per_day,p_avg_runtime_minutes,p_days_per_month,NULL) hrs,
           __FQ__.get_dbu_price(p_cloud,p_region,p_tier,__FQ__.get_product_type_for_pricing('DLT',false,p_photon_enabled,p_dlt_edition,NULL,NULL)) price,
           __FQ__.get_vm_cost_per_hour(p_cloud,p_region,p_driver_node_type,'on_demand','NA') drv,
           __FQ__.get_vm_cost_per_hour(p_cloud,p_region,p_worker_node_type,'on_demand','NA') wrk)
  SELECT 'DLT_'||upper(COALESCE(p_dlt_edition,'CORE')), dbu_ph, hrs, dbu_ph*hrs, price, round(dbu_ph*hrs*price,2),
         round((drv + wrk*COALESCE(p_num_workers,0))*hrs,2),
         round(dbu_ph*hrs*price + (drv + wrk*COALESCE(p_num_workers,0))*hrs,2) FROM b

estimate_fmapi_databricks_cost.routine_definition:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT __FQ__.get_fmapi_databricks_dbu(p_cloud,p_model,p_rate_type,p_quantity) dbu_m,
         __FQ__.get_dbu_price(p_cloud,p_region,p_tier,'SERVERLESS_REAL_TIME_INFERENCE') price)
  SELECT 'FMAPI_DATABRICKS', 0.0, 0.0, dbu_m, price, round(dbu_m*price,2), 0.0, round(dbu_m*price,2) FROM b

WITH b AS (
  SELECT __FQ__.get_fmapi_proprietary_dbu(p_cloud,p_provider,p_model,p_endpoint_type,p_context_length,p_rate_type,p_quantity) dbu_m,

           CASE WHEN upper(p_provider)='GOOGLE' THEN 'GEMINI_MODEL_SERVING' ELSE upper(p_provider)||'_MODEL_SERVING' END) price)
  SELECT 'FMAPI_PROPRIETARY', 0.0, 0.0, dbu_m, price, round(dbu_m*price,2), 0.0, round(dbu_m*price,2) FROM b

estimate_jobs_classic_cost.routine_definition:
WITH b AS (
    SELECT __FQ__.calculate_classic_compute_dbu(p_cloud,p_driver_node_type,p_worker_node_type,p_num_workers,p_photon_enabled,'JOBS',NULL) dbu_ph,
           __FQ__.calculate_hours_per_month('JOBS',p_runs_per_day,p_avg_runtime_minutes,p_days_per_month,NULL) hrs,
           __FQ__.get_dbu_price(p_cloud,p_region,p_tier,__FQ__.get_product_type_for_pricing('JOBS',false,p_photon_enabled,NULL,NULL,NULL)) price,
           __FQ__.get_vm_cost_per_hour(p_cloud,p_region,p_driver_node_type,'on_demand','NA') drv,
           __FQ__.get_vm_cost_per_hour(p_cloud,p_region,p_worker_node_type,'on_demand','NA') wrk)
  SELECT 'JOBS_CLASSIC', dbu_ph, hrs, dbu_ph*hrs, price, round(dbu_ph*hrs*price,2),
         round((drv + wrk*COALESCE(p_num_workers,0))*hrs,2),
         round(dbu_ph*hrs*price + (drv + wrk*COALESCE(p_num_workers,0))*hrs,2) FROM b

estimate_lakebase_cost.routine_definition:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT __FQ__.calculate_lakebase_dbu(p_capacity_units,p_ha_nodes) dbu_ph,
         24.0*COALESCE(p_days_per_month,30) hrs,
         __FQ__.get_dbu_price(p_cloud,p_region,p_tier,'DATABASE_SERVERLESS_COMPUTE') price)
  SELECT 'LAKEBASE', dbu_ph, hrs, dbu_ph*hrs, price, round(dbu_ph*hrs*price,2), 0.0, round(dbu_ph*hrs*price,2) FROM b

estimate_serverless_compute_cost.routine_definition:
WITH b AS (
    SELECT __FQ__.calculate_serverless_compute_dbu(p_cloud,p_driver_node_type,p_worker_node_type,p_num_workers,p_workload_type,p_serverless_mode) dbu_ph,
           __FQ__.calculate_hours_per_month(p_workload_type,p_runs_per_day,p_avg_runtime_minutes,p_days_per_month,NULL) hrs,
           __FQ__.get_dbu_price(p_cloud,p_region,p_tier,__FQ__.get_product_type_for_pricing(p_workload_type,true,true,NULL,NULL,NULL)) price)
  SELECT upper(p_workload_type)||'_SERVERLESS', dbu_ph, hrs, dbu_ph*hrs, price, round(dbu_ph*hrs*price,2),
         0.0, round(dbu_ph*hrs*price,2) FROM b

estimate_sized_workload.comment: Size a cluster for a described workload (size_cluster) and price it with the Lakemeter functions (DBU price from ref_dbu_price_card; NULL cost = PENDING price). Rows: compute_option JOBS_CLASSIC (DBU + VM on the recommended cluster) and JOBS_SERVERLESS (no worker limit, no cluster start), each for scenario LOW / EXPECTED / HIGH (throughput range). Use when the user describes data volume and frequency but no cluster. p_data_gb = GB per day. Weekly: p_runs_per_day 1, p_days_per_month 4. p_window_minutes = time each run may take.
estimate_sized_workload.full_data_type: (compute_option STRING, scenario STRING, workload_profile STRING, node_type STRING, num_workers INT, photon_enabled BOOLEAN, runtime_minutes_per_run INT, runs_per_day INT, days_per_month INT, hours_per_month DOUBLE, dbu_per_hour DOUBLE, dbu_per_month DOUBLE, dbu_price DOUBLE, dbu_cost_per_month DOUBLE, vm_cost_per_month DOUBLE, total_cost_per_month DOUBLE, status STRING, window_minutes INT, throughput_basis STRING, options STRING, price_basis STRING, sizing_basis STRING)

estimate_sized_workload.routine_definition:
WITH a AS (
    SELECT coalesce(CASE WHEN upper(trim(p_cloud)) IN ('', 'NULL', 'NONE', 'N/A') THEN NULL ELSE upper(trim(p_cloud)) END, 'AWS') AS cl,
           coalesce(CASE WHEN upper(trim(p_region)) IN ('', 'NULL', 'NONE', 'N/A') THEN NULL ELSE lower(trim(p_region)) END, 'us-east-1') AS rg,
           coalesce(CASE WHEN upper(trim(p_tier)) IN ('', 'NULL', 'NONE', 'N/A') THEN NULL ELSE upper(trim(p_tier)) END, 'ENTERPRISE') AS tr,
           p_workload AS w, p_data_gb AS gb, p_runs_per_day AS rpd_in, p_window_minutes AS win_in, p_node_type AS node_in,
           p_max_workers AS maxw_in, p_photon_enabled AS ph_in, coalesce(p_days_per_month, 30) AS dpm),
  s AS (
    SELECT z.*, a.cl, a.rg, a.tr, a.dpm, coalesce(a.ph_in, z.photon_recommended) AS ph,
           CASE WHEN z.always_on THEN 1 ELSE z.runs_per_day END AS rpd
    FROM a, LATERAL __FQ__.size_cluster(a.w, a.gb, a.rpd_in, a.win_in, a.cl, a.node_in, a.maxw_in, a.rg) z),
  k AS (
    SELECT s.*, x.scenario,
           CASE x.scenario WHEN 'LOW' THEN s.workers_low WHEN 'HIGH' THEN s.workers_high ELSE s.num_workers END AS cw,
           CASE x.scenario WHEN 'LOW' THEN s.runtime_minutes_low WHEN 'HIGH' THEN s.runtime_minutes_high ELSE s.runtime_minutes_expected END AS crt,
           CASE x.scenario WHEN 'LOW' THEN s.serverless_workers_low WHEN 'HIGH' THEN s.serverless_workers_high ELSE s.serverless_workers_expected END AS sw,
           CASE x.scenario WHEN 'LOW' THEN s.serverless_runtime_minutes_low WHEN 'HIGH' THEN s.serverless_runtime_minutes_high ELSE s.serverless_runtime_minutes_expected END AS srt
    FROM s, (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('LOW'), ('EXPECTED'), ('HIGH') AS v(scenario)) x)
  SELECT 'JOBS_CLASSIC', k.scenario, k.workload_profile, k.node_type, k.cw, k.ph, k.crt, k.rpd, k.dpm, e.hours_per_month,
         e.dbu_per_hour, e.dbu_per_month, e.dbu_price, e.dbu_cost_per_month, e.vm_cost_per_month, e.total_cost_per_month,
         CASE WHEN k.always_on THEN k.status WHEN k.crt <= k.window_minutes THEN 'FITS_WINDOW' ELSE 'EXCEEDS_WINDOW' END,
         k.window_minutes, k.throughput_basis, k.options,
         concat('DBU price: ', __FQ__.get_dbu_price_status(k.cl, k.rg, k.tr, __FQ__.get_product_type_for_pricing('JOBS', false, k.ph, NULL, NULL, NULL)),
                '; VM: cloud on-demand list price (ref_vm_costs)'), k.assumptions
  FROM k, LATERAL __FQ__.estimate_jobs_classic_cost(k.cl, k.rg, k.tr, k.node_type, k.node_type, k.cw, k.ph, k.rpd, k.crt, k.dpm) e
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'JOBS_SERVERLESS', k.scenario, k.workload_profile, concat('serverless (sized as ', k.sw, ' x ', k.node_type, ')'), k.sw, true,
         k.srt, k.rpd, k.dpm, e.hours_per_month,
         e.dbu_per_hour, e.dbu_per_month, e.dbu_price, e.dbu_cost_per_month, e.vm_cost_per_month, e.total_cost_per_month,
         CASE WHEN k.always_on OR k.srt <= k.window_minutes THEN 'FITS_WINDOW' ELSE 'EXCEEDS_WINDOW' END, k.window_minutes, k.throughput_basis, NULL,
         concat('DBU price: ', __FQ__.get_dbu_price_status(k.cl, k.rg, k.tr, __FQ__.get_product_type_for_pricing('JOBS', true, true, NULL, NULL, NULL))), concat(k.assumptions, ' Serverless: sized to fit the window with no worker limit; no cluster start billed.')
  FROM k, LATERAL __FQ__.estimate_serverless_compute_cost(k.cl, k.rg, k.tr, 'JOBS', k.node_type, k.node_type, k.sw, 'standard', k.rpd, k.srt, k.dpm) e
  WHERE k.serverless_ok

estimate_vector_search_cost.routine_definition:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT __FQ__.calculate_vector_search_dbu(p_cloud,p_mode,p_capacity_millions) dbu_ph,
         24.0*COALESCE(p_days_per_month,30) hrs,
         __FQ__.get_dbu_price(p_cloud,p_region,p_tier,'SERVERLESS_REAL_TIME_INFERENCE') price)
  SELECT 'VECTOR_SEARCH', dbu_ph, hrs, dbu_ph*hrs, price, round(dbu_ph*hrs*price,2), 0.0, round(dbu_ph*hrs*price,2) FROM b

get_dbu_price_status.routine_definition:
coalesce(
  (SELECT CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN concat('PENDING - ', source)
               ELSE concat(status, ' $', price_per_dbu, '/DBU ', billing_sku, ' (', source, ')') END
   FROM __FQ__.ref_dbu_price_card
   WHERE cloud = upper(p_cloud) AND region = lower(p_region) AND tier = upper(p_tier) AND product_type = upper(p_product_type) LIMIT 1),
  concat('PENDING - no price-card row for ', upper(p_tier), ' ', upper(p_product_type), ' in ', upper(p_cloud), ' ', lower(p_region),
         ' (region not loaded into ref_dbu_price_card)'))

get_fmapi_databricks_dbu.routine_definition:
COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(is_hourly,false) THEN p_quantity*dbu_rate
  ELSE (p_quantity / cast(COALESCE(input_divisor,1) as double)) * dbu_rate END
  FROM __FQ__.ref_fmapi_databricks_rates
  WHERE upper(cloud)=upper(p_cloud) AND upper(model)=upper(p_model) AND lower(rate_type)=lower(p_rate_type) LIMIT 1), 0)

get_fmapi_proprietary_dbu.comment: FM API (proprietary models) DBU for a quantity: hourly rate x hours, else (tokens / input_divisor) x rate.

get_fmapi_proprietary_dbu.routine_definition:
COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(is_hourly,false) THEN p_quantity*dbu_rate
  ELSE (p_quantity / cast(COALESCE(input_divisor,1) as double)) * dbu_rate END
  FROM __FQ__.ref_fmapi_proprietary_rates
  WHERE upper(cloud)=upper(p_cloud) AND upper(provider)=upper(p_provider) AND upper(model)=upper(p_model)
    AND lower(endpoint_type)=lower(COALESCE(p_endpoint_type,'global')) AND lower(context_length)=lower(COALESCE(p_context_length,'all'))
    AND lower(rate_type)=lower(p_rate_type) LIMIT 1), 0)

get_photon_multiplier.routine_definition:
CASE
  WHEN NOT COALESCE(p_photon_enabled,false) AND NOT COALESCE(p_serverless_enabled,false) THEN 1.0
  ELSE COALESCE((SELECT multiplier FROM __FQ__.ref_dbu_multipliers
    WHERE upper(cloud)=upper(p_cloud) AND feature='photon'
      AND upper(sku_type)=upper(CASE upper(p_workload_type)
        WHEN 'DLT' THEN 'DLT_'||upper(COALESCE(p_dlt_edition,'CORE'))||'_COMPUTE'
        WHEN 'JOBS' THEN 'JOBS_COMPUTE'
        WHEN 'ALL_PURPOSE' THEN 'ALL_PURPOSE_COMPUTE'
        ELSE 'JOBS_COMPUTE' END) LIMIT 1), 1.0)
END

get_product_type_for_pricing.routine_definition:
CASE upper(p_workload_type)
  WHEN 'JOBS' THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(p_serverless_enabled,false) THEN 'JOBS_SERVERLESS_COMPUTE'
                        WHEN COALESCE(p_photon_enabled,false) THEN 'JOBS_COMPUTE_(PHOTON)' ELSE 'JOBS_COMPUTE' END
  WHEN 'ALL_PURPOSE' THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(p_serverless_enabled,false) THEN 'ALL_PURPOSE_SERVERLESS_COMPUTE'
                        WHEN COALESCE(p_photon_enabled,false) THEN 'ALL_PURPOSE_COMPUTE_(PHOTON)' ELSE 'ALL_PURPOSE_COMPUTE' END
  WHEN 'DLT' THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(p_serverless_enabled,false) THEN 'JOBS_SERVERLESS_COMPUTE'
                        ELSE 'DLT_'||upper(COALESCE(p_dlt_edition,'CORE'))||'_COMPUTE'||CASE WHEN COALESCE(p_photon_enabled,false) THEN '_(PHOTON)' ELSE '' END END
  WHEN 'DBSQL' THEN CASE upper(COALESCE(p_dbsql_warehouse_type,'')) WHEN 'SERVERLESS' THEN 'SERVERLESS_SQL_COMPUTE' WHEN 'PRO' THEN 'SQL_PRO_COMPUTE' ELSE 'SQL_COMPUTE' END
  ELSE upper(p_workload_type)||'_COMPUTE' END

get_vm_cost_per_hour.routine_definition:
COALESCE((SELECT cost_per_hour FROM __FQ__.ref_vm_costs
  WHERE upper(cloud)=upper(p_cloud) AND upper(region)=upper(p_region)
    AND upper(instance_type)=upper(p_instance_type)
    AND upper(pricing_tier)=upper(p_pricing_tier)
    AND upper(payment_option)=upper(COALESCE(p_payment_option,'NA')) LIMIT 1), 0)

size_cluster.comment: Recommend a classic job cluster for a described workload when the user does not know the cluster size. p_workload: INGESTION, ETL, STREAMING (always-on), ML_TRAINING, ML_INFERENCE (or an alias). p_data_gb: GB processed per day (ML_TRAINING: per run). p_window_minutes: time each run may take (default per profile). Sized on EXPECTED throughput so each run fits the window; runtime_minutes_low/expected/high give the range on that cluster. status FITS_WINDOW or EXCEEDS_WINDOW / EXCEEDS_POLICY (then read options). Worker limit from ref_sizing_policy. No rows = unknown workload type or no data volume.

size_cluster.routine_definition:
WITH i AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN upper(trim(p_workload)) IN ('', 'NULL', 'NONE', 'N/A') THEN NULL ELSE upper(regexp_replace(trim(p_workload), '[ -]+', '_')) END AS w,
           p_data_gb AS gb, greatest(coalesce(p_runs_per_day, 1), 1) AS rpd, p_window_minutes AS win_in, p_max_workers AS maxw_in,
           coalesce(CASE WHEN upper(trim(p_cloud)) IN ('', 'NULL', 'NONE', 'N/A') THEN NULL ELSE upper(trim(p_cloud)) END, 'AWS') AS cl,
           CASE WHEN upper(trim(p_node_type)) IN ('', 'NULL', 'NONE', 'N/A') THEN NULL ELSE trim(p_node_type) END AS node,
           CASE WHEN upper(trim(p_region)) IN ('', 'NULL', 'NONE', 'N/A') THEN NULL ELSE lower(trim(p_region)) END AS rg),
  p AS (
    SELECT s.*, i.*,
           CASE WHEN s.volume_basis = 'PEAK_HOUR' THEN i.gb / 24.0 * s.peak_factor ELSE i.gb / i.rpd END AS sgb,
           CASE WHEN s.always_on THEN 60 ELSE greatest(coalesce(i.win_in, s.default_window_minutes), s.startup_minutes + 1) END AS win,
           greatest(coalesce(i.maxw_in, pol.max_workers, 100), 1) AS pmax,
           CASE WHEN i.maxw_in IS NOT NULL THEN 'given by the user' ELSE coalesce(pol.source, 'default guardrail') END AS pmax_src,
           pol.allowed_node_pattern AS allow_pat
    FROM i JOIN __FQ__.ref_sizing_profiles s ON i.w = s.profile OR array_contains(split(s.aliases, ','), i.w)
    LEFT JOIN __FQ__.ref_sizing_policy pol ON pol.cloud = i.cl
    WHERE i.gb IS NOT NULL AND i.gb > 0),
  q AS (
    SELECT p.*, greatest(win - startup_minutes, 1) / 60.0 AS eff_h, sgb * working_set_factor AS req_mem FROM p),
  c AS (
    SELECT q.*, d.instance_type, d.vcpus, d.memory_gb, d.dbu_rate,
           q.sgb / (q.gb_per_core_hour_expected * q.eff_h) AS req_cores,
           cast(ceil(q.sgb / (q.gb_per_core_hour_expected * q.eff_h) / d.vcpus) AS INT) AS n_cpu,
           cast(ceil(q.req_mem / d.memory_gb) AS INT) AS n_mem
    FROM q JOIN __FQ__.ref_instance_dbu_rates d ON upper(d.cloud) = q.cl AND d.is_active
    WHERE (q.node IS NOT NULL AND lower(d.instance_type) = lower(q.node))
       OR (q.node IS NULL
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM __FQ__.ref_sizing_node_families f
                       WHERE f.cloud = q.cl AND f.node_category = q.node_category
                         AND d.instance_type RLIKE f.instance_pattern AND d.vcpus >= f.min_vcpus)
           AND (q.allow_pat IS NULL OR d.instance_type RLIKE q.allow_pat)
           AND (q.rg IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM __FQ__.ref_vm_costs v
                                        WHERE upper(v.cloud) = q.cl AND lower(v.region) = q.rg
                                          AND v.instance_type = d.instance_type AND lower(v.pricing_tier) = 'on_demand')))),
  n AS (SELECT c.*, greatest(min_workers, n_cpu, n_mem) AS need FROM c),
  best AS (
    SELECT n.*, least(need, pmax) AS wk FROM n
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN need <= least(preferred_max_workers, pmax) THEN 0 WHEN need <= pmax THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
             CASE WHEN need <= pmax THEN vcpus ELSE -vcpus END, dbu_rate
    LIMIT 1),
  r AS (
    SELECT b.*,
           CASE WHEN always_on THEN 1440 ELSE cast(ceil(startup_minutes + greatest(min_runtime_minutes, 60.0 * sgb / (gb_per_core_hour_high * wk * vcpus))) AS INT) END AS rt_l,
           CASE WHEN always_on THEN 1440 ELSE cast(ceil(startup_minutes + greatest(min_runtime_minutes, 60.0 * sgb / (gb_per_core_hour_expected * wk * vcpus))) AS INT) END AS rt_e,
           CASE WHEN always_on THEN 1440 ELSE cast(ceil(startup_minutes + greatest(min_runtime_minutes, 60.0 * sgb / (gb_per_core_hour_low * wk * vcpus))) AS INT) END AS rt_h,
           CASE WHEN always_on THEN least(pmax, greatest(min_workers, cast(ceil(sgb / gb_per_core_hour_high / vcpus) AS INT), n_mem)) ELSE wk END AS wk_l,
           CASE WHEN always_on THEN least(pmax, greatest(min_workers, cast(ceil(sgb / gb_per_core_hour_low / vcpus) AS INT), n_mem)) ELSE wk END AS wk_h,
           CASE WHEN always_on THEN greatest(min_workers, cast(ceil(sgb / gb_per_core_hour_high / vcpus) AS INT), n_mem) ELSE need END AS sw_l,
           CASE WHEN always_on THEN greatest(min_workers, cast(ceil(sgb / gb_per_core_hour_low / vcpus) AS INT), n_mem) ELSE need END AS sw_h
    FROM best b)
  SELECT profile, description, gb, rpd, round(sgb, 3), CASE WHEN always_on THEN NULL ELSE win END,
         instance_type, instance_type, wk, least(min_workers, wk), least(pmax, greatest(wk, wk_h)),
         vcpus, memory_gb, wk * vcpus, wk * memory_gb, round(dbu_rate * (wk + 1), 4),
         round(req_cores, 2), round(req_mem, 2), need, pmax, pmax_src,
         CASE WHEN need > pmax THEN 'POLICY_CAP'
              WHEN need = min_workers AND n_cpu < min_workers AND n_mem < min_workers THEN 'MIN_WORKERS'
              WHEN n_mem > n_cpu THEN 'MEMORY' ELSE 'CORES' END,
         CASE WHEN need > pmax THEN CASE WHEN always_on THEN 'EXCEEDS_POLICY' ELSE 'EXCEEDS_WINDOW' END
              WHEN NOT always_on AND rt_e > win THEN 'EXCEEDS_WINDOW' ELSE 'FITS_WINDOW' END,
         rt_l, rt_e, rt_h, wk_l, wk_h,
         cast(ceil(need / pmax) AS INT),
         sw_l, need, sw_h,
         CASE WHEN always_on THEN 1440 ELSE cast(ceil(greatest(min_runtime_minutes, 60.0 * sgb / (gb_per_core_hour_high * sw_l * vcpus))) AS INT) END,
         CASE WHEN always_on THEN 1440 ELSE cast(ceil(greatest(min_runtime_minutes, 60.0 * sgb / (gb_per_core_hour_expected * need * vcpus))) AS INT) END,
         CASE WHEN always_on THEN 1440 ELSE cast(ceil(greatest(min_runtime_minutes, 60.0 * sgb / (gb_per_core_hour_low * sw_h * vcpus))) AS INT) END,
         startup_minutes, always_on, photon_default, serverless_ok,
         cast(greatest(wk * vcpus * 2, 200) AS INT),
         gb_per_core_hour_low, gb_per_core_hour_expected, gb_per_core_hour_high,
         CASE WHEN calibration_status = 'CALIBRATED'
              THEN concat('CALIBRATED from ', calibration_runs, ' job runs (', date_format(calibrated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), ')')
              ELSE 'ASSUMED planning values (not yet calibrated with job history)' END,
         CASE WHEN need > pmax AND NOT always_on THEN concat(
                'Needs ', need, ' x ', instance_type, ' workers to finish in ', win, ' min but the worker limit is ', pmax, ' (', pmax_src, '). Options: ',
                '(1) run on the ', wk, '-worker cluster, about ', rt_e, ' min per run; ',
                '(2) split into ', cast(ceil(need / pmax) AS INT), ' parallel jobs of up to ', pmax, ' workers each; ',
                '(3) serverless jobs (no worker limit)', CASE WHEN serverless_ok THEN '' ELSE ' - not suited to this workload type' END, '; ',
                '(4) ask for a higher worker limit.')
              WHEN need > pmax THEN concat('Needs ', need, ' workers to keep up but the worker limit is ', pmax, ' (', pmax_src, '): split the stream or raise the limit.')
              WHEN NOT always_on AND rt_e > win THEN concat('The minimum runtime (', rt_e, ' min incl. ', startup_minutes, ' min cluster start) is longer than the ', win, '-minute window.')
              ELSE NULL END,
         concat('Planning estimate - validate with a test run. Sized on ', round(sgb, 2), ' GB',
                CASE WHEN volume_basis = 'PEAK_HOUR' THEN concat(' in the peak hour (daily GB / 24 x ', peak_factor, ')') ELSE ' per run' END,
                CASE WHEN always_on THEN ', always on 24 x 7' ELSE concat(' to finish within ', win, ' min') END,
                '; throughput ', gb_per_core_hour_low, ' / ', gb_per_core_hour_expected, ' / ', gb_per_core_hour_high, ' GB per core-hour (low / expected / high)',
                CASE WHEN working_set_factor > 0 THEN concat('; memory ', working_set_factor, ' GB per GB sized') ELSE '; memory not a constraint (data streams through)' END,
                CASE WHEN always_on THEN '' ELSE concat('; ', startup_minutes, ' min cluster start, min ', min_runtime_minutes, ' min runtime') END,
                '; worker limit ', pmax, ' (', pmax_src, ')',
                CASE WHEN node IS NOT NULL THEN concat('; node type ', instance_type, ' given by the user') ELSE concat('; smallest ', lower(node_category), ' node that fits') END,
                '. Throughput ', CASE WHEN calibration_status = 'CALIBRATED' THEN concat('calibrated from ', calibration_runs, ' job runs') ELSE 'values are assumed' END, '.'),
         tips
  FROM r
